# Spaceezy

> Spaceezy is a real estate discovery platform that publishes projects and properties with live prices, configurations, availability and direct enquiries. It helps buyers compare homes by location and connect with the Spaceezy team for guidance, site visits and documentation support.

## Overview

- [Spaceezy homepage](https://spaceezy.com/): Published real estate projects and properties in Ghaziabad and surrounding locations, with current prices and availability.

## About Spaceezy

- [About Spaceezy](https://spaceezy.com/about): The company's story, leadership and values. Spaceezy was founded to make finding a home more transparent, with curated options, honest advice and end-to-end support.

The website describes the following services: zero brokerage on partner and new developer projects, dedicated relationship managers for site visits, legal and documentation assistance, and post-sales support. It also states that listings are verified and that project pages include RERA registration details where available.

## Real Estate CRM

Spaceezy CRM is the customer relationship management system behind Spaceezy's real estate operations. Verified capabilities include website enquiry capture, lead stages and assignments, follow-up tasks, duplicate detection by phone number, property matching, project/configuration/unit inventory, site-visit scheduling, bookings and quotations, customer and call records, a WhatsApp shared inbox with document attachments, Meta Ads campaign and lead sync, role-based permissions, audit logs and reporting from live data. It is used by sales executives, managers, administrators and channel partners in the Spaceezy workflow. No CRM pricing or conversion results are published.

- [Real Estate CRM overview](https://spaceezy.com/real-estate-crm): What a real estate CRM is and how Spaceezy CRM supports lead, visit and inventory workflows.
- [Lead management](https://spaceezy.com/real-estate-crm/lead-management): Enquiry capture, pipeline stages, assignments, follow-ups, duplicates and property matching.
- [Site visit management](https://spaceezy.com/real-estate-crm/site-visits): Scheduling, ownership and visit status tracking, including missed visits.
- [Inventory management](https://spaceezy.com/real-estate-crm/inventory): Projects, configurations, units, pricing and availability records.

- [Dream Homes](https://spaceezy.com/projects/dream-homes-e84e51): A residential project by Wave Group in Wave City, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, with 1 BHK, 2 BHK and 3 BHK configurations and RERA information.
